description: A task stopped in review resumes: the item In review with an open pull request is checked out and watched, with no new branch and no decision scan (a headless scan writes each question as a comment with `needs-owner`: `gh_not_before` refuses any before the checkout). The watch finds the one failed lane stopped by the usage limit, so the run says so on the issue and stops. Not reachable yet: the fake `gh pr checkout` leaves the copy on `main`, so the three expectations after it (the watch, the comment, the label) are not met and the run exits 1 until the owner answers the question on the scenario's issue; an exit 1 on those three is no regression.
